recognize_zh: CD61 染色讓巨核細胞呈強烈棕色，細胞大小不一且成群聚集，核呈球根狀、雲朵狀分葉並深染，另見散在小型陽性碎片；這種群聚且型態異常的巨核細胞符合骨髓增殖性腫瘤纖維化期。
features: Strong cytoplasmic CD61 staining in megakaryocytes
Megakaryocytes clustered in loose and tight aggregates, variable in size
Nuclei hyperlobated to bulbous, cloud-like, some hyperchromatic
Scattered small CD61-positive cells/fragments and platelets
Background CD61-negative hematopoietic cells, adipocytes, and a streaming stromal area at right
describe_en: CD61 immunohistochemistry on the bone marrow core biopsy highlights increased megakaryocytes forming loose and tight clusters. The megakaryocytes vary in size and have hyperlobated, bulbous or cloud-like nuclei, some hyperchromatic, with strong cytoplasmic staining; scattered small CD61-positive cells and platelet fragments are also present. The background includes CD61-negative hematopoietic cells, adipocytes, and a streaming stromal area suggestive of fibrosis. In the setting of polycythemia vera, findings are consistent with post-polycythemic myelofibrosis, to be correlated with reticulin staining.

ddx.vs: PMF megakaryocytes look the same at the fibrotic stage, so the distinction relies on documented prior PV and clinical history.
MDS megakaryocytes are small, hypolobated, or micromegakaryocytes rather than large clustered bulbous forms, and MPN driver mutations are usually absent.
Tumor cells are CD61-negative and keratin-positive, whereas these large cells are megakaryocytes confirmed by CD61.
